Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649954. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as inner join, filter by assay_id from assays where chembl_id equals CHEMBL4649954, filter standard_value not null and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Return all matching rows without deduplication.
